competitiveTarget: Beat generic buyer-intent pages: honest value props (live MLS data, local licensed broker, no hand-offs), a specific process walkthrough, buyer strategy sub-pages, and a clear listing-alerts CTA. Zero invented stats.
note: Phase 9 page-class migration to the KB (kinetic-brutalist) design system, RESTYLED IN PLACE. The page keeps every section, the getSurfaceImage hero DAL fetch, all value props, the process walkthrough, the buyer-guide sub-pages, the CTA band, the full 6-item FAQ, and the BreadcrumbList + WebPage + FAQPage JSON-LD. Presentation moved to KB: KB shell (KbNav + KbFooter + SmoothScrollProvider + KbSectionTracker), KbBreadcrumb, and KB-styled in-place sections (hero/value-props/process/guides/CTA/FAQ) using the .section/.wrap/.sec-head rhythm + Amboqia display headings + hard --edge borders. HideChrome hides the default SiteHeader/SiteFooter for /buy. MetadataBlock owns the canonical FAQPage schema, so the in-place FAQ renders no duplicate JSON-LD. Lead path unchanged: /lp/buyer-listing-alerts (FUB buyer workflow), no embedded form.
